services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A full tear-off and a new roof, priced before you sign.
services.text: Professional roof replacement using quality materials, with the decking inspected and every pipe jack, vent and flashing replaced as part of the job.
services.imageAlt: A completed roof replacement by STX Roofing on a home in The Woodlands, Texas
body: Replacing a roof is a major investment, and the contractor you pick changes both the performance and the value. We start every project with a detailed inspection to assess the roof's condition and to confirm whether a full replacement is genuinely necessary. From there we walk you through materials, warranties and costs so the decision is yours to make with the numbers in front of you.

Houston gets roughly 50 inches of rain a year, which makes hidden decking rot common here, and it is the most common way a replacement turns into a bait-and-switch. A low bid wins the job, the tear-off starts, the rotten decking is discovered, and change orders appear. We inspect your decking before anything is signed, and we replace pipe jacks, vents and flashing as part of every replacement. We do not reuse old components to lower a bid. A $50 pipe jack replaced now saves a $5,000 leak repair later, and that math is in your estimate before you sign.
Clay and concrete tile roofs are replaced differently than shingle, and we handle both.
points: Comprehensive roof inspection before replacement is recommended
Material selection and planning for durability, style and budget
Full tear-off and professional installation by our own crew
Pipe jacks, vents and flashing replaced, never reused
Final inspection and full cleanup of the property
Lifetime labor warranty on qualifying residential roofs

faqs.q: How much does it cost to replace a roof in Houston?
faqs.a: A typical Houston residential replacement runs roughly $7,000 to $13,000 depending on the home's square footage, roof complexity and the materials you choose. We give you a detailed written estimate before we start so there are no surprise change orders mid-project.

faqs.q: How long is the labor warranty?
faqs.a: Most Houston roofers warranty their labor for 5 to 10 years. Ours runs for the life of your ownership on qualifying residential roof systems, and the labor is also backed by third-party Directorii.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, storm damage and normal wear, fixed fast.
services.text: Fast, dependable residential roof repair, from minor leaks to storm damage, with honest recommendations and no unnecessary upselling.
services.imageAlt: A new roof vent set into a repaired shingle roof in Houston
body: Your roof is your home's first line of defense, and even small issues turn into costly damage if they sit. We inspect carefully, tell you plainly what we found, and tailor the repair to the roof's condition rather than selling you something larger. Our specialists repair asphalt shingle, metal and specialty systems, and apply methods that hold up to local weather.

Every roof repair we complete is backed by a 2-year workmanship warranty. Most Houston roofers warranty repair work for 30 to 90 days. If something we repaired fails inside that window, we come back and fix it. Emergency repair calls within roughly 25 miles of Huffman are handled the same day in most cases.

We are a repair company first and a replacement company when that is genuinely the right answer. Most Houston roofs come back to us at least once for a repair before they need replacing, and we are glad to handle the smaller jobs.
points: Leak and storm damage repair
Flashing and shingle repair
Pipe boot and roof vent replacement
Asphalt shingle, metal and specialty systems
2-year workmanship warranty on every repair
Same-day emergency calls within about 25 miles of Huffman

faqs.q: When is a repair the right call?
faqs.a: When the damage is localized — a few damaged shingles, one section of failed flashing, a leaking pipe boot — the roof is under 12 years old and in good condition, storm damage is limited to a defined area, there is no widespread granule loss or curling, and the decking underneath is sound.

faqs.q: When does replacement make more sense?
faqs.a: When the roof is 15 or more years old and your insurance carrier is asking questions at renewal, or when multiple repair points exist across different sections of the roof.

services.title: Impact-Resistant Roofing
services.short: Class 4 shingles, and what they do and do not do.
services.text: Class 3 and Class 4 impact-resistant roof systems, with a straight answer on what the rating covers, what it does not, and how your carrier treats it.
body: Impact resistance has a lab test behind it. Most impact-rated shingles are tested under UL 2218, where steel balls from 1.25 to 2 inches across are dropped onto new roofing samples. Class 4, the top rating, means the material takes two hits in the same spot from a 2-inch ball dropped 20 feet without cracking or splitting. Class 3 uses a 1.75-inch ball. A second standard, FM 4473, fires ice balls instead.

It helps to know the limits. Those tests use new, unweathered material at room temperature, so a rating is not a true measure of how a roof handles every real storm. In our experience a Class 4 shingle shrugs off hits that would bruise a standard one. It is not hail-proof, and no honest roofer will tell you it is. Wind is rated by separate tests, so we check both ratings before we recommend a product. Around Houston the bigger threat is often wind and the debris it throws at your roof rather than hail.

The Texas Department of Insurance says a Class 4 roof covering gets the highest premium credit, but each insurer sets its own amount, so call your agent before you choose a shingle. We confirm the actual product carries a UL 2218 Class 4 label rather than just the product family, and we tell you to keep the product name and class printed on the bundle wrapper. Texas has a form for this, TDI Form PC068, the Impact-Resistant Roofing Installation Form, and some insurers ask for it before they apply a discount.
points: Class 3 and Class 4 impact-rated shingle systems
Both the impact rating and the wind rating checked before we recommend a product
The UL 2218 class confirmed on the actual product, not the product family
Your policy read with you so the upgrade decision uses real numbers

faqs.q: Will a Class 4 roof lower my premium?
faqs.a: The Texas Department of Insurance says a Class 4 roof covering gets the highest premium credit, but each insurer sets its own amount. Most of our customers live inland, outside the coastal area served by the Texas Windstorm Insurance Association, so the discount question usually goes to a private carrier rather than TWIA. Ask your agent before you choose a shingle.

services.title: Gutter Installation
services.short: Seamless gutter formed on site, sized to the roof.
services.text: Custom-fit gutter installation that directs water away from the walls and the foundation, roll-formed on site so the only joints are at corners and end caps.
body: Gutters have one job: move water off the roof and away from the foundation. In Houston that job is harder than it sounds, because our rainfall comes in bursts and our soil is shrink-swell clay that punishes any water left standing near the slab. A few inches of rain on an average roof produces several thousand gallons of water, and all of it has to go somewhere.

We roll-form gutter on site from a continuous coil, so each run comes off the machine as one piece. Sectional gutter sold in ten-foot lengths has a joint every ten feet, and joints are where gutters leak. Sizing is the other decision: five inch trough with two by three inch downspouts handles most single-story roofs, while six inch trough with three by four inch downspouts moves substantially more water and is usually the better answer on two-story homes, steep pitches or long runs. We calculate the roof area draining to each run rather than defaulting to whatever the builder installed.

We also handle the fascia and soffit behind the gutter. That wood is where overflow does its damage, and fixing gutters without fixing rotted fascia solves nothing. Gutter projects are scheduled rather than same-day, since we form the material on site.
points: Seamless gutter roll-formed on site from continuous coil
Trough and downspout sizing calculated from the roof area

services.title: Emergency Roof Repair and Tarping
services.short: 24/7 response, with the water stopped tonight.
services.text: Emergency roof repair and professional tarping, available 24 hours a day including nights and weekends, with same-day response in most cases within about 25 miles of Huffman.
body: An emergency is any roof problem letting water in right now: a limb or debris through the roof, a section of shingles peeled off in high wind, water pouring in during rain, or storm damage that left the deck open to the sky. A stain that has been there for months can wait for a normal appointment. A new active leak cannot, because every hour adds to the repair bill inside the house rather than on the roof.

You call (281) 601-7663 and tell us what is happening, day or night, and you talk to a local team rather than a call center. We photograph the damage from the roof before anything gets covered up, then make the home safe and dry with a professional tarp or a temporary patch. We check the attic for wet decking and insulation, and we give you a written plan and a timeline for the permanent repair.

A tarp is a temporary cover, not a repair. A proper one is heavy-duty, extends well past the damaged area, wraps over the ridge where possible so water cannot run under the top edge, and is held down with wood battens fastened through the tarp rather than bricks or tires. Loose tarps catch the wind and tear more shingles loose. Emergency tarping is usually covered by a policy as mitigation because it stops further damage, so keep the receipt. We have answered emergency calls here since 2016.
points: Available 24 hours a day, including nights and weekends
Same-day response in most cases within about 25 miles of Huffman
Professional heavy-duty tarping battened down, not weighted down
Damage photographed from the roof before it is covered up
Attic checked for wet decking and insulation
Written assessment and plan for the permanent repair

faqs.q: Do you tarp at night and on weekends?
faqs.a: Yes. We are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, including nights and weekends. In most cases we can respond the same day within about 25 miles of Huffman.

faqs.a: No. After a Houston storm the door knockers come out fast and use the panic of a fresh leak to get a signature. We have a real shop in Huffman at 25419 FM 2100 and an A+ BBB rating, and we will still be here next year.

We install, replace, repair and restore commercial roofing systems on industrial facilities, retail plazas, warehouses, multi-family properties and office buildings.

Ignoring damage leads to major expense. On multi-family and HOA portfolios, coordination, sequencing and resident communication are part of the job.

services.title: Commercial Roof Coatings and Restoration
services.short: Years of service life added without a tear-off.
services.text: Roof coating and restoration for a commercial roof that is aging but not ready for replacement, applied only where the roof qualifies.
body: A roof coating buys you years without a tear-off, but only on a roof that qualifies, and that distinction is where most building owners get it wrong. If the membrane is sound and the insulation underneath is dry, a restoration system can extend service life and cut cooling load for a fraction of what replacement costs. ENERGY STAR guidance on cool roofs notes that a clean, reflective surface stays dramatically cooler than a dark one, which lowers air conditioning demand and slows how fast the roof materials degrade.

If water has already reached the insulation, coating over it seals the problem in. That is why every project starts with a commercial roof inspection and core samples before we recommend anything. We work on all the major single-ply membrane systems, so the recommendation is not driven by what we happen to install.

A restoration means cleaning and repairing the existing roof, then applying a seamless protective coating that bonds to the surface. Silicone, acrylic and spray polyurethane foam are the usual options, and each forms a waterproof barrier that reflects UV, seals cracks and adds years to a flat or low-slope roof. Coatings pair well with scheduled commercial roof maintenance, which is what keeps a restored roof performing.

about.title: A veteran-owned, family-operated Houston roofing company
text: STX Roofing was founded by United States Air Force veteran Russell Mullin, and our company culture is rooted in the same values he lived by while serving: integrity first, service before self, and excellence in everything we do. Those principles guide every decision we make, from how we communicate with customers to how we complete each project.

We understand that hiring a roofing contractor is stressful, especially when your home or business is on the line. That is why we prioritize clear communication, transparency and accountability through every phase of the project. Establishing trust from day one is what makes the experience a smoother one. Our goal is simple: 100% customer satisfaction on every job.

Russell founded the company after years working as an insurance adjuster and insurance salesperson, and water damage claims were a large part of that work. We are based in Huffman, we work residential and commercial under one set of standards, and our focus is to keep customers educated and informed through every phase of their project.
